properties.notes: Allocated in the Central Area Action Plan with outline consent for 450 dwellings in total on the site with 45 already completed - 405 residual.. Outline application seeking redevelopment to provide mixed-use development to include office, residential, shops, restaurants & cafes, drinking establishments, hot food takeaways, healthcare facilities (including a PCT Healthcare facility), hotel, leisure, car parking (including multi-storey car park), bus interchange, public realm and associated highways works - Access not reserved.
